_scope: Direct-provider text/chat API list prices. Not ChatGPT, Claude, Kimi or Grok subscriptions. See docs/billing.md.
_warning: Estimates from a dated public documentation snapshot and caller-supplied usage. Not an invoice; omitted charges and unpriced records are excluded. Verify current provider pricing before relying on budgets.
